title: Price-only baselines on FED-PXTX-ALL-REL5-v2 validation
question: After correcting the release-text checks (v2), how do Persistence, the frozen none+CNN~none~none, none+DLinear~none~none and none+Ridge~none~none compare on the text-verified validation releases?
configuration: Same frozen forecasters as fed-spx-matched-control-v1, all trained on FED-PX-REL5-v1 train (978 releases). Scored on FED-PXTX-ALL-REL5-v2 validation: 149 releases, 139 release instants, 125 dates, unit weight per instant, paired 10-date block intervals. Test not loaded.
finding: Persistence MAE 16.155 / 20.484 bp at 20 / 30 minutes. none+CNN~none~none 16.057 / 20.392 bp (gain +0.088 / +0.054 bp, intervals include zero). none+DLinear~none~none 16.751 / 20.892 bp and none+Ridge~none~none 19.295 / 23.928 bp are worse than Persistence.
limitations: Validation only; CNN epochs were selected on the 207 FED-PX-REL5-v1 validation rows, which contain these 149. Inferred evidence classes are included. Intervals of about +/-0.3 bp mean only a text gain of roughly half a basis point or more can register.

figure.alt: Grouped bars of validation MAE at 20 and 30 minutes on 149 releases. Persistence and the frozen CNN are nearly equal; DLinear is about 0.6 bp higher and ridge about 3 bp higher.
